== Notes ==

* Despite having the same appearance as a [[Skeleton Wizard]], Zoldark is a [[fleshy]] creature.
* Both Zoldark and his minions are considered [[undead]].
* His [[Minion of Zoldark|Minions of Zoldark]] are not considered [[summoned creature]]s; they will not trigger the full effects of [[anti-summon skill]]s.

* He starts with high [[health]] and uses [[buff]]s to increase his [[armor rating]]; however, he cannot [[heal]] himself nor can he [[health regeneration|regenerate health]]. 
* Whenever he uses [[Animate Undead]] (to restore his minions), he loses 5% of his maximum health. He will stop using the skill when his health drops to 25-50%. His health can drop suddenly when his [[Master of Necromancy]] ends.

* There are several common techniques used against him:
** Concentrate on his minions, forcing him to sacrifice 5% of his health each time he re-animates them; you can double that effect by using [[Scourge Sacrifice]].
** Use [[melee counter]] skills to defend against the minions.
** Use [[armor-ignoring damage]] against him.
** Bring [[holy damage]], which is also helpful to reach his lair.
